title: PostCSS
description: A tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript plugins.

data.text: PostCSS is a tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript plugins. It powers many popular tools like Autoprefixer, cssnano, and Tailwind CSS. With PostCSS, you can use future CSS syntax today, auto-add vendor prefixes, and optimize your styles.

data.title: PostCSS Configuration
data.content: Configure PostCSS with the autoprefixer plugin.

terms.definition: A JavaScript module that transforms CSS tokens during the PostCSS processing pipeline.
A PostCSS plugin that adds vendor prefixes to CSS rules using data from Can I Use.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: PostCSS transforms CSS with JavaScript plugins
Powers Tailwind CSS, Autoprefixer, and cssnano
Enables future CSS syntax in current browsers
data.takeaway: PostCSS is the foundation of modern CSS tooling and build pipelines.
